summary: Observable contract from brief.md for formatDuration and independent local tests.

requirements.description: Format finite nonnegative integer numbers of seconds as hours:minutes:seconds.
requirements.acceptance: 0 yields 00:00:00, 59 yields 00:00:59, 60 yields 00:01:00, 3599 yields 00:59:59, and 3600 yields 01:00:00; -0 is accepted as zero.

requirements.description: Hours have at least two digits and may grow past 99; minutes and seconds always have two digits.
requirements.acceptance: 359999 yields 99:59:59 and 360000 yields 100:00:00. Finite integer Number values above the safe integer limit and Number.MAX_VALUE are accepted and represented using the integer value actually supplied, with decimal hours and no wrapping or exponential notation.

requirements.description: Reject every non-number argument with TypeError.
requirements.acceptance: Strings, undefined, null, booleans, arrays, objects, boxed numbers, bigint, symbols, and functions throw TypeError without coercion.

requirements.description: Reject negative, fractional, or non-finite number arguments with RangeError.
requirements.acceptance: Negative integers, positive and negative fractions, NaN, Infinity, and -Infinity throw RangeError.

requirements.description: Add independent behavior tests for the existing pure local utility.
requirements.acceptance: A local Node test suite calls the exported function and compares outputs with independently specified literal fixtures and exact error classes, including formatting boundaries and invalid arguments.

constraints.description: Keep the change in the existing src/duration.mjs module and add independent local tests; no deployment, data store, or network endpoint.
Work only inside the isolated trial project, do not alter the installed playbook, and stop after collecting evidence and generating a handoff before completing verification or readiness.
